import.saveFailed: Could not import. Check for products already added on another phone, then try again.
import.csvOnly: Choose a .csv file. In Excel or Sheets, use Save as CSV first.
import.fileLarge: This file is too large. Use a file under 2 MB.
import.csvFormat: This CSV could not be read. Check the commas and quote marks, then save as CSV again.
import.csvEmpty: No products found in this file.
import.csvHeaders: This file needs name and sell_price columns. Download the example file to see the format.
import.csvExtra: This file has columns we cannot check here. Use the example file with name, unit, sell_price, buy_price, qty and barcode.
import.csvTooMany: Import up to 500 products at once. Split this file into smaller files.
import.duplicateName: This name is already in the shop or file.
import.badUnit: Choose piece, packet, box, kg or litre.
import.badSell: Enter a selling price above ₹0 and up to ₹1,00,000.
import.badBuy: Buying price must be blank or ₹0 to ₹1,00,000.
import.badQty: Enter valid opening stock. Use whole pieces or up to two decimals for kg/litres.
import.duplicateBarcode: This barcode is already in the shop or file.

activation.title: Open your paid shop
activation.intro: Enter the temporary password given by the seller, then choose your own password. Your shop will open on this phone.
activation.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. Keep this password private.
activation.wrongTemporary: Email or temporary password is wrong. Ask the seller to check it.
activation.failed: Could not activate the shop. Check your connection or ask the seller for help.
activation.notConfigured: Online shop activation is not set up yet. Ask the seller for help.
activation.changedButRecoverFailed: Your password changed, but the shop did not finish loading. Go to login and use the cloud recovery option with your new password.

restoreEntry.title: Restore your shop
restoreEntry.intro: Choose your saved backup first. We will show you the shop before you restore it.
restoreEntry.accountPrompt: Set up sign-in on this phone
restoreEntry.accountHint: Use the same email and password if this phone already has your account. Your backup stays on this phone.
restoreEntry.readError: Could not read this file. Try again.
restoreEntry.restoreError: Could not restore this shop. Try again.
restoreEntry.shortPassword: Use at least 6 characters for the password.
restoreEntry.existingShop: This account already has a shop on this phone. Log in to restore from More.
restoreEntry.wrongAccountPassword: This email is already on this phone. Enter its existing password.

pricing.title: Simple prices for your shop
pricing.intro: Choose one plan for one shop. Both include the same core app. Pay yearly or pay once for lifetime access.

lifetime.name: Lifetime
lifetime.sub: For a shop staying for the long run
lifetime.term: Pay once. No yearly renewal for the core app.

pricing.copied: Copied. Send this message to the Vyaplio seller.
pricing.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please try again on a secure connection.
pricing.oneShop: Prices are for one shop. No monthly plan.
pricing.lifetimeScope: Lifetime means access to this shop's core Vyaplio app for the life of the product. Future separate paid modules or service packages are not included.
pricing.noCheckout: This page does not collect payment or activate a plan. Confirm the final terms and payment with the seller.

firstWeek.title: Your first week
firstWeek.intro: Five small steps. Do them when you have time. You can skip a step and return here from Home or More.
firstWeek.allDone: Ready for the daily routine. You can come back to these steps any time.
firstWeek.saveFailed: Could not save this step. Try again.
firstWeek.productsHint: Start with the products you sell most. Add their selling prices; you can add the rest later.
firstWeek.practiceHint: Choose an item and see what a bill would total. This practice does not save a bill or change stock.
firstWeek.noItem: Add a priced product first, then return here.
firstWeek.practiceSafe: Practice only: no bill, payment or stock change is saved.
firstWeek.stockHint: Open Stock and check the quantity of one product against what is really on the shelf.
firstWeek.backupHint: Save a backup file outside this phone, or complete cloud sync. This step finishes only when a copy is made.
firstWeek.closeHint: At the end of a working day, count the cash and save the day's close.

phoneAuth.protectHint: Verify your number on this same cloud account. Then it can restore your shop on a new phone. SMS requires your cloud project's phone provider.
phoneAuth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Indian mobile number.
phoneAuth.failed: Could not verify. Check the code or your SMS provider settings.
phoneAuth.recoverHint: Use a number already verified on this shop's cloud account. Internet and SMS are needed.
phoneAuth.offlinePassword: New password for this phone (at least 6 characters)
phoneAuth.offlineHint: Keep this password safe. It lets you open this phone when offline; the SMS code is for recovering the cloud shop.
phoneAuth.passwordShort: Enter at least 6 characters for the new phone password.

closeout.title: Today's shop check
closeout.intro: Three short steps before you finish today
closeout.closed: Today's cash has been counted and closed ✓
closeout.upiClear: No UPI payments waiting to confirm ✓
closeout.issuesHint: You can close the cash drawer even if these need attention. They stay on the alerts screen.
closeout.reasonHint: For example, change given or cash added
closeout.late: {count} entries changed after closing. Check the cash details.
closeout.cashHint: Count actual cash, including change. UPI is separate. You can correct a closed day with a reason in Cash details.
closeout.shareHint: Open WhatsApp with today's figures. You choose whether and whom to send it to.
closeout.openShare: The summary will say that the cash count is still open.
closeout.changed: Today's cash changed while you were counting. Check the new expected amount and try again.
closeout.failed: Could not close today. Please try again.
closeout.waStock: Stock to check: {shortage} mismatches · {low} low · {expiring} expiring

quickProduct.intro: Check the price and count what is in the shop now.
quickProduct.buyHint: Leave blank if unknown. Profit will show as unknown.
quickProduct.countHint: If the count differs, the change is saved in stock history.
quickProduct.changed: This product changed while open. Close it and open again to see the latest values.
quickProduct.invalid: Check price and quantity. Pieces must be whole numbers.
